description: This file defines the Rectangle class within the Thunder::Core namespace, including its data members, constructors, comparison operators, geometric operations like combine, intersection, overlap check, and containment check.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A class representing a rectangle with position (x, y) and size (w, h), providing methods for comparison, combination, intersection, overlap detection, and containment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are equal based on their position and size.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are not equal.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Expands the rectangle to include another rectangle, effectively creating the minimal bounding rectangle.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two rectangles as a new rectangle.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the union of two rectangles as a new rectangle.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a point (tx, ty) lies within the rectangle.
